title: Chapter 131 Worthy Of Entrusting A Lifetime
content:
Chapter 131 Worthy Of Entrusting A Lifetime

I searched all over the Hongmeng Universe!

As soon as these words came out, An Xing was completely stunned.

When I looked at Xiao Yun's childhood again, only tenderness was left in my eyes.

"Yun'er, I'm sorry."

Hearing this, Xiao Yuner shook her head slightly.

"It's enough to see you still alive."

Half of the reason why Xiao Yuner was able to go all the way to the upper realm after soaring to the upper realm was because of the obsession with finding An Xing.

When Xiao Yun'er learned that An Xing killed Yun Sect alone for him, he was moved.

She has helped many people, but the one who impressed her the most was An Xing.

What's more, An Xing himself is also very successful.

The name of a peerless genius is not a joke.

"Yun'er,"

At this time, An Xing directly grabbed Xiao Yun'er's hand.

Suddenly, Xiao Yun'er's face became even more rosy, but she did not resist at all.

"Yun'er, actually, I,"

"What?"

"I've always liked it,"

"An Xing!!"

At this moment, a loud shout suddenly sounded from afar.

Hearing this sound, An Xing's body suddenly shook.

Damn it, why at this time!

The next moment, a tall figure walked towards the place angrily.

It is Gu Chen, one of the members of the Single Dog Alliance.

At this time, Gu Chen wanted to yell, An Xing, you kid was fired!

"Gu, brother Gu, haha, what a coincidence."

When An Xing saw Gu Chen, he was selling the blame in his heart, but he still smiled on the surface.

Hearing this, Gu Chen sneered, "Haha, it's really a coincidence."

Looking at the woman beside An Xing, how could Gu Chen not understand?

What's more, my hand is still holding it!

The evidence is conclusive.

At this time, Xiao Yuner, who was beside him, said, "Xiao An, who is this?"

Upon hearing this, An Xing was about to speak, but Gu Chen cleared his throat and said, "Girl, Gu Chen is down there, he is An Xing's friend."

"Gu Chen?"

Xiao Yun'er frowned slightly, was silent for a moment, and suddenly remembered.

"You are the mortal emperor of the Xuangu Galaxy!"

Xiao Yuner has been to and learned about the Xuan Gu Galaxy.

Emperor Fan joined the deserted city and ascended together.

At that time, she had guessed whether An Xing would ascend together.

Obviously, her guess was right.

At this time, Gu Chen nodded, "No, it's right."

On the side, An Xing suddenly became a little nervous.

Sure enough, Xiao Yun'er turned her head and looked at An Xing, and asked, "Xiao An, are you hiding something from me?"

Upon hearing this, An Xing waved his hand quickly, "Yun'er, how could I deceive you?"

He really didn't lie to Xiao Yun'er, he really just found a position in the deserted city.

But the position may be a billion.

After a while, the three of them came to a teahouse together.

"You mean, after you enter the land of nothingness, not only is it okay, but you have become stronger?"

Xiao Yun'er said in surprise.

An Xing nodded.

"I have a body of nothingness, but I didn't know it at that time, and I didn't wake up."

"Yun'er, I wanted to awaken the body of nothingness in the land of nothingness and go back, but,

He didn't expect that he would meet a noble person who would affect his life in the land of nothingness.

Lu Daosheng!

Since Xiao Yuner was coerced to marry someone else, An Xing understood that only by becoming stronger can all troubles be solved.

So in the face of Lu Daosheng's invitation, An Xing agreed.

However, I did become stronger later, but I lost what I once wanted to have the most.

And now, fate has given him a big surprise.

Xiao Yun'er came to find him.

"Yun'er, are you willing to give me a chance?"

At this time, An Xing grabbed Xiao Yun'er's hand and suddenly said.

Hearing this, Xiao Yun'er smiled.

"You think, why should I come to you?"

Upon hearing this, An Xing immediately smiled and then pulled Xiao Yun'er into his arms.

On the side, Gu Chen remained silent.

At this time, he had already regretted following him.

That guy Awei found a wife and then the city lord showed off his affection.

And now, An Xing, you actually made this happen.

After a long time, the clown was actually himself.

At this moment, he really wanted to leave with a slap in the table, but he couldn't.

"Ahem."

Gu Chen coughed twice.

An Xing and the others immediately remembered that there was a light bulb next to them.

Then the two of them quickly separated, Xiao Yuner's face turned slightly red, and An Xing smiled and said, "Brother Gu, what's wrong?"

Hearing this, Gu Chen sneered, "What's wrong? You won't forget what you do, right?"

"Or, you don't want to do it anymore."

"If you don't want to do it, you can just say that when the city lord comes back, I will report to the city lord."

Hearing this, An Xing paused.

I actually forgot the important thing.

It's so damn!

"Brother Gu, nothing happened in the city, right?"

An Xing asked quickly.

Hearing this, Gucheng snorted lightly, without answering.

There is nothing, but everyone is still waiting for your information.

They did not have any power to mobilize the Gen Organization. Lu Daosheng trusted An Xing very much and almost gave the Gen Organization to An Xing with all his power.

As for whether there are any other moves, they don't know.

"Xiao An, what exactly do you do in the deserted city?"

At this time, Xiao Yun'er, who had been silent all the time, suddenly asked.

Although she guessed that An Xing had a special status in the deserted city, she still wanted to know more.

After hearing Xiao Yun'er's words, An Xing hesitated.

Your identity really can't be said casually.

At least not here.

"Yun'er, I..."

"What's wrong?"

Xiao Yun'er asked puzzledly.

"I'll take you to a place."

An Xing and Gu Chen looked at each other and said.

Then, the two took Xiao Yun'er to the time and space tunnel.

"Master Gu."

Seeing Gu Chen, the guard hurriedly said respectfully.

Gu Chen nodded and said, "Let's go in."

Xiao Yun'er looked at the time and space tunnel in front of her with some shock, and then followed An Xing and the others into it.

Buzz——

A flash of light.

The three of them immediately came to the deserted city of Xuanling Star Domain.

Seeing the drastic changes around her, Xiao Yun'er was a little shocked.

She didn't know much about the deserted city in the Wanling Realm.

After all, she had only ascended not long ago.

And now, she had come to a new place.

"An Xing, where is this?"

Xiao Yun'er asked in confusion.

On the side, An Xing smiled and said, "Yun'er, this is also a deserted city, but it's a little bigger."

At this moment, a desert guard with a terrifying aura suddenly appeared in front of the three people.

"Lord An, Lord Gu, my leader is waiting for you two."

The desert guard bowed his head and said respectfully.

Seeing the desert guard in front of her, Xiao Yun'er's face trembled.

Such a strong aura.

"Got it."

An Xing turned his head and looked at Xiao Yun'er, who was still a little shocked.

"Yun'er, let's go."

Then, the somewhat confused Xiao Yun'er was led by An Xing to the direction of the City Lord's Mansion.

After layers of strict guards, the three finally arrived at their destination.

Along the way, Xiao Yun'er has gone from being shocked to being numb.

She thought that the deserted city in the Wanling Realm was already very exaggerated.

Unexpectedly, this place is even more terrifying.

Looking at An Xing, who was serious beside her, she suddenly realized that the boy who was about to starve to death back then has become a peerless strong man who can stand alone.

At this time, An Xing noticed Xiao Yun'er's gaze and smiled back.

As if to say, don't be afraid, I'm here.

Seeing this, Xiao Yun'er immediately laughed.

This man is worth entrusting her life to.
